title.zh: 卷315 列傳一百二 高天喜 鄂实 三格 和起 唐喀禄 阿敏道 满福 豆斌 端济布 诺尔本
title.en: Volume 315 Biographies 102: Gao Tianxi, E Shi, San Ge, He Qi, Tang Kalu, A Min Dao, Man Fu, Dou Bin, Duan Ji Bu, Nuo Er Ben
title.raw: 卷315 列傳一百二 高天喜 鄂实 三格 和起 唐喀禄 阿敏道 满福 豆斌 端济布 诺尔本

sentences.zh: 列傳一百二

translations.literal: Biographies 102
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 102

sentences.zh: 高天喜鄂實三格和起唐喀祿阿敏道滿福

translations.literal: Gao Tianxi, E Shi, San Ge, He Qi, Tang Kalu, A Min Dao, Man Fu
translations.idiomatic: Gao Tianxi, E Shi, San Ge, He Qi, Tang Kalu, A Min Dao, Man Fu

sentences.zh: 豆斌端濟布諾爾本

translations.literal: Dou Bin, Duan Ji Bu, Nuo Er Ben
translations.idiomatic: Dou Bin, Duan Ji Bu, Nuo Er Ben

sentences.zh: 高天喜，甘肅西寧人。

translations.literal: Gao Tianxi was a native of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Tianxi was a native of Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 天喜本準噶爾人，雍正中為我師所俘。

translations.literal: Tianxi was originally a Zunghar; in the Yongzheng reign he was captured by our forces.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi was originally a Zunghar; during the Yongzheng reign he was taken prisoner by our army.

sentences.zh: 高氏撫為子，因從其族籍。

translations.literal: The Gao family raised him as a son, and he thus followed their clan register.
translations.idiomatic: The Gao family adopted and raised him as a son, and he accordingly entered their clan register.

sentences.zh: 從軍，累擢保寧堡守備。

translations.literal: He entered military service and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander of Baoning Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He took up military service and rose in repeated promotions to garrison commander of Baoning Fort.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，副將軍兆惠擊伊犁，天喜從參將邁斯漢赴援。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong, Vice General Zhaohui attacked Ili; Tianxi followed Major Maisihan to the relief expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong, Vice General Zhaohui struck at Ili; Tianxi went with Major Maisihan on the relief column.

sentences.zh: 遇噶勒雜特賊百餘，擊殺之，獲其駝馬。

translations.literal: They encountered over a hundred Galjut bandits, killed them, and seized their camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: They met more than a hundred Galjut rebels, killed them, and captured their camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 既，聞兆惠被困濟爾哈朗，議馳救，邁斯漢怯不進。

translations.literal: Later, hearing that Zhaohui was trapped at Jierhalang, they discussed rushing to his rescue, but Maisihan was cowardly and would not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, learning that Zhaohui was besieged at Jierhalang, they debated a forced march to relieve him, but Maisihan was timid and refused to go forward.

sentences.zh: 巴里坤辦事大臣雅爾哈善以聞，上即奪邁斯漢官以命天喜。

translations.literal: Yalihashan, the minister in charge at Barkul, reported this; the Emperor immediately stripped Maisihan of his post and entrusted command to Tianxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yalihashan, the minister in charge at Barkul, reported the matter; the Emperor at once removed Maisihan from office and gave the command to Tianxi.

sentences.zh: 尋遷金塔協副將。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to deputy commander at Jinta.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to deputy commander at Jinta.

sentences.zh: 再遷西寧鎮總兵，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to commander of Xining Garrison and appointed a leading detachments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to commander of the Xining garrison and appointed a leading detachments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十月，師攻葉爾羌，兆惠議出間道襲取賊輜重，渡黑水。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, the army attacked Yarkand; Zhaohui planned to take a bypath to strike the enemy baggage train and cross the Black Water.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year the army attacked Yarkand; Zhaohui proposed a detour to strike the enemy supply train and cross the Black Water.

sentences.zh: 天喜督兵修橋渡師，未及半，賊大至。

translations.literal: Tianxi supervised troops in building a bridge to ferry the army across; before half had crossed, the enemy arrived in force.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi directed his men in building a bridge to get the army across; before even half had crossed, the enemy came up in strength.

sentences.zh: 天喜聞兆惠陷賊陣，舍橋亟赴之，奮與賊戰，與鄂實、三格、特通額俱沒於陣。

translations.literal: Tianxi heard that Zhaohui was trapped in the enemy formation; abandoning the bridge he hurried to his aid and fought fiercely; he perished in battle together with E Shi, San Ge, and Tetong'e.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxi heard that Zhaohui was caught in the enemy lines, he abandoned the bridge and rushed to him, fighting desperately; he fell in battle together with E Shi, San Ge, and Tetong'e.

sentences.zh: 上賦詩惜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem lamenting his loss.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote a poem to mourn him.

sentences.zh: 諡果義，又賜其家白金千。

translations.literal: He was posthumously titled Guoyi ["Resolute Loyalty"], and a thousand taels of silver were also granted to his family.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Guoyi ("Resolute Loyalty"), and a thousand taels of silver were also bestowed on his household.

sentences.zh: 鄂實，西林覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，大學士鄂爾泰第二子。

translations.literal: E Shi, of the Xilin Gioro clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and the second son of Grand Secretary Ortai.
translations.idiomatic: E Shi belonged to the Xilin Gioro clan, served in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner, and was the second son of Grand Secretary Ortai.

sentences.zh: 出為叔父鄂禮後。

translations.literal: He was made heir to his uncle E Li.
translations.idiomatic: He was established as heir to his uncle E Li.

sentences.zh: 自廕生授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Through yin privilege he was appointed a third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: By yin privilege he received appointment as a third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷本旗副都統、左翼前鋒統領。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of his Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in repeated promotions to vice commander of his Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 兄鄂容安死阿睦爾撒納之亂，鄂實請從軍，授參贊大臣，佐定邊將軍成袞扎布，出西路。

translations.literal: His elder brother Erong'an died in the Amursana rebellion; E Shi requested to take the field and was appointed a participating commissioner, assisting the Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Erong'an died in the Amursana rebellion; E Shi asked to join the campaign and was made a participating commissioner, assisting Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab on the western route.

sentences.zh: 二十二年夏，成袞扎布令逐捕扎那噶爾布，鄂實以地險馬疲，中道引還。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-second year, Chengunjab ordered pursuit of Zanagarbu; E Shi, citing difficult terrain and exhausted horses, turned the army back midway.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-second year Chengunjab ordered pursuit of Zanagarbu; E Shi, pleading difficult terrain and weary horses, led the army back halfway.

sentences.zh: 上手詔詰責曰：「若謂地險，賊何以能行？

translations.literal: The Emperor personally issued an edict of rebuke, saying: "If you say the terrain is difficult, how can the rebels move there?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor personally issued an edict of rebuke: "If you say the ground is difficult, how can the rebels travel it?

sentences.zh: 若謂馬疲，賊馬何獨能壯健？

translations.literal: If you say the horses are exhausted, why alone are the rebel horses strong and fit?
translations.idiomatic: If you say the horses are weary, why are the rebels' horses alone strong and fit?

sentences.zh: 」左授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: " He was demoted to a Blue-Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: " He was demoted to Blue-Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 是冬，鄂實逐扎哈沁賊，斬一百四十餘級，獲牲械。

translations.literal: That winter E Shi pursued the Zakhachin bandits, beheading over a hundred and forty and seizing livestock and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: That winter E Shi pursued the Zakhachin rebels, beheading more than a hundred and forty and capturing livestock and arms.

sentences.zh: 上謂：「今當大雪，馬力應疲乏，尚能勦賊。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Now in deep snow the horses ought to be weary, yet they can still exterminate the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor remarked: "Now, in heavy snow, the horses ought to be exhausted, yet you can still destroy the enemy.

sentences.zh: 彼時鄂實為參贊大臣，有事但諉諸將軍。

translations.literal: At that time E Shi was a participating commissioner and passed every matter off to the general.
translations.idiomatic: At that time E Shi was a participating commissioner and shifted every matter onto the general.

sentences.zh: 茲以負罪，乃直前勦賊，朕知其隱矣。

translations.literal: Now, bearing guilt, he presses forward to exterminate the enemy—I know his hidden motive."
translations.idiomatic: Now, under a burden of guilt, he presses forward to destroy the enemy—I see his hidden motive."

sentences.zh: 」量遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: He was promoted by one grade to third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted by one grade to third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 死事，上令仍視前鋒統領賜卹，諡果壯。

translations.literal: Having died in service, the Emperor ordered condolence payments as for the vanguard commander and posthumously titled him Guozhuang ["Resolute and Bold"].
translations.idiomatic: He died in service; the Emperor ordered condolence payments as for a vanguard commander and granted the posthumous title Guozhuang ("Resolute and Bold").

sentences.zh: 三格，棟鄂氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: San Ge, of the Dong'o clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: San Ge, of the Dong'o clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自諸生授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: From student status he was appointed a Blue-Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: From student status he was appointed Blue-Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 累遷黑龍江副都統。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 命將索倫、巴爾呼兵三千，佐參贊大臣策楞出西路，為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead three thousand Solon and Barhu troops to assist the participating commissioner Celeng on the western route, as a leading detachments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to command three thousand Solon and Barhu troops assisting participating commissioner Celeng on the western route, serving as a leading detachments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 策楞以怯懦逮，三格亦坐奪官。

translations.literal: Celeng was arrested for cowardice, and San Ge was also deprived of rank for complicity.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng was arrested for cowardice, and San Ge was also stripped of office for complicity.

sentences.zh: 旋复授正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was soon reappointed vice commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reappointed vice commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 攻呼爾璊台吉賽音伯勒克等，再戰，掠其牧地，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: Attacking the Khoyiru'n chieftain Sayinbolok and others, he fought twice, raided their pastures, and was granted a hereditary office of third-rank light chariot commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking the Khoyiru'n chieftain Sayinbolok and others, he fought twice, raided their pastures, and received a hereditary office of third-rank light chariot commandant.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春，定邊將軍成袞扎布令逐捕扎那噶爾布，未得。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year the Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab ordered pursuit of Zanagarbu without success.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab ordered pursuit of Zanagarbu, but he was not taken.

sentences.zh: 秋，師至博羅和羅，遇叛黨額林沁達瓦等百餘戶，三格與戰。

translations.literal: In autumn the army reached Boluheluo and encountered over a hundred rebel households led by Elinjindawa; San Ge joined battle.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn the army reached Boluheluo and met more than a hundred rebel households under Elinjindawa; San Ge gave battle.

sentences.zh: 會布魯古特台吉琿齊、呼爾璊台吉達瓦斬扎那噶爾布偽請降，並請招額林沁達瓦，三格信之，遽引師還，琿齊等旋遁去。

translations.literal: The Burut chieftain Hunchi and the Khoyiru'n chieftain Dawa had beheaded Zanagarbu and falsely requested surrender, also asking to summon Elinjindawa; San Ge believed them and abruptly led the army back, whereupon Hunchi and the others at once fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Burut chieftain Hunchi and the Khoyiru'n chieftain Dawa had killed Zanagarbu and falsely offered surrender, also asking to summon Elinjindawa; San Ge believed them, abruptly led the army back, and Hunchi and the others soon fled.

sentences.zh: 坐奪官，並削世職，以兵伍自效。

translations.literal: He was stripped of rank and hereditary office and ordered to redeem himself as a common soldier.
translations.idiomatic: He was deprived of office and hereditary rank and ordered to serve as a common soldier to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 死事，上命仍視副都統賜卹，諡剛勇。

translations.literal: Having died in service, the Emperor ordered condolence payments as for a vice commander and posthumously titled him Gangyong ["Staunch and Brave"].
translations.idiomatic: He died in service; the Emperor ordered condolence payments as for a vice commander and granted the posthumous title Gangyong ("Staunch and Brave").

sentences.zh: 天喜、鄂實、三格並祀昭忠祠，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Tianxi, E Shi, and San Ge were all enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls and granted hereditary offices of cavalry commandant with concurrent cloud-rider commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxi, E Shi, and San Ge were all enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls and granted hereditary offices of cavalry commandant with concurrent cloud-rider commandant.

sentences.zh: 回部平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the Muslim frontier was pacified, their portraits were placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muslim regions were pacified, their portraits were hung in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 特通額，策楞子也，附見策楞傳。

translations.literal: Tetong'e, the son of Celeng—see his father's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Tetong'e was Celeng's son; see the biography of Celeng.

sentences.zh: 和起，馬佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: He Qi, of the Majia clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He Qi, of the Majia clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 其先世阿音布，國初以軍功授拜他喇布勒哈番世職。

translations.literal: His ancestor Ayinbu, at the founding of the dynasty, received for military merit a hereditary office of baitalabulehafan.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor Ayinbu, at the dynasty's founding, received for military merit a hereditary office of baitalabulehafan.

sentences.zh: 和起襲職，授盛京協領。

translations.literal: He Qi inherited the office and was appointed an assistant commandant at Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: He Qi inherited the office and was appointed assistant commandant at Mukden.

sentences.zh: 累擢寧夏副都統。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年，命與侍衛海福將千人佐定西將軍永常討達瓦齊，遷寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he was ordered, with the guardsman Haifu, to lead a thousand men assisting the Pacification Commissioner in the West Yongchang against Dawachi, and was promoted to commander of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he was ordered, with guardsman Haifu, to lead a thousand men assisting Pacification Commissioner in the West Yongchang against Dawachi, and was promoted to commander of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 永常劾和起兵不及額，而和起先疏言將九百人以往，留百人護輜重，上得永常疏，不之罪也。

translations.literal: Yongchang impeached He Qi for falling short in troop numbers, but He Qi had earlier memorialized that he would lead nine hundred men forward and leave a hundred to guard the baggage; when the Emperor received Yongchang's memorial, he did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang impeached He Qi for falling short of the required troop strength, but He Qi had earlier memorialized that he would lead nine hundred men forward and leave a hundred to guard the baggage train; when the Emperor received Yongchang's memorial, he did not punish He Qi.

sentences.zh: 尋又命偕提督豆斌為巴里坤辦事大臣，策楞代永常為定西將軍，复劾和起送兵馬遲誤，當奪官，留任。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered, together with Provincial Commander Dou Bin, to serve as minister in charge at Barkul; Celeng replaced Yongchang as Pacification Commissioner in the West and again impeached He Qi for delays in dispatching troops and horses, for which he should have been deprived of rank but was retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again ordered, together with Provincial Commander Dou Bin, to serve as minister in charge at Barkul; Celeng replaced Yongchang as Pacification Commissioner in the West and again impeached He Qi for delays in dispatching troops and horses—he should have been stripped of rank but was kept in office.

sentences.zh: 旋复官，授欽差大臣關防，召詣京師諮軍事。

translations.literal: He was soon restored to rank, granted the seal of an imperial commissioner, and summoned to the capital to consult on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored to rank, granted the seal of an imperial commissioner, and summoned to the capital for consultation on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 達什達瓦所屬宰桑訥默庫、曼集、烏達瑚們都等在軍私還游牧，命和起嚴鞫得實，以降人請予寬典，上不許，命正軍法。

translations.literal: Naimuku, Manji, Udahu, and others, chieftains subordinate to Dashi Dawa, had on their own returned to pasturing while in the army; He Qi was ordered to investigate rigorously and established the facts; surrendered men asked leniency, but the Emperor did not permit it and ordered execution under military law.
translations.idiomatic: Naimuku, Manji, Udahu, and others, chieftains under Dashi Dawa, had privately returned to pasturing while still with the army; He Qi was ordered to investigate rigorously and established the facts; surrendered men pleaded for leniency, but the Emperor refused and ordered execution under military law.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十一月，輝特台吉巴雅爾叛，掠扎哈沁五百餘戶。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the twenty-first year, the Khoyitu'n chieftain Bayar rebelled and raided over five hundred households of the Zakhachin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twenty-first year the Khoyitu'n chieftain Bayar rebelled and plundered more than five hundred Zakhachin households.

sentences.zh: 定邊右副將軍兆惠令和起將索倫兵百人往按，檄吐魯番伯克莽阿里克等集闢展，而噶勒雜特宰桑哈薩克錫喇、布魯特台吉尼瑪陰應巴雅爾，詭以兵五百會。

translations.literal: Vice Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui ordered He Qi to lead a hundred Solon troops to investigate, and directed the Turfan beg Mangalik and others to gather at Bicheng, but the Galjut chieftain Hasakesira and the Burut chieftain Nima secretly aided Bayar and falsely agreed to meet with five hundred troops.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui ordered He Qi to lead a hundred Solon troops to investigate, and directed the Turfan beg Mangalik and others to assemble at Bicheng; meanwhile the Galjut chieftain Hasakesira and the Burut chieftain Nima secretly supported Bayar and falsely promised to join with five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 和起望兵至，疑之。

translations.literal: He Qi saw troops approaching and grew suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When He Qi saw troops approaching, he grew suspicious.

sentences.zh: 令莽阿里克诇之，紿告曰：「我兵也！

translations.literal: He ordered Mangalik to spy on them; they deceptively reported, "These are our troops!
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Mangalik to reconnoiter them; they deceived him with the report, "These are our troops!

sentences.zh: 」逾時，尼瑪等操戈前，莽阿里克自後譟，賊眾蜂集。

translations.literal: " After a time Nima and the others advanced with weapons drawn; Mangalik raised an uproar from the rear, and the rebel masses swarmed forth.
translations.idiomatic: " After a while Nima and the others advanced with weapons in hand; Mangalik raised a clamor from the rear, and the rebel masses swarmed in.

sentences.zh: 和起所將兵僅百人，負重創，手刃數賊，股中槍，徒步轉戰，至夜力盡。

translations.literal: The troops He Qi commanded numbered only a hundred; grievously wounded, he personally slew several enemies; shot in the thigh, he fought on foot until night, when his strength was spent.
translations.idiomatic: The force He Qi commanded numbered only a hundred; badly wounded, he personally killed several enemies; struck by gunfire in the thigh, he fought on foot until night, when his strength gave out.

sentences.zh: 和起垂死，命索倫侍衛努古德、彰金布突圍出，以所戴孔雀翎為識報兆惠，遂死之。

translations.literal: As He Qi lay dying he ordered the Solon guardsmen Nugude and Zhangjinbu to break out of the encirclement, using his peacock feather insignia as a token to report to Zhaohui, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: As He Qi lay dying he ordered the Solon guardsmen Nugude and Zhangjinbu to break through the encirclement, using the peacock feather he wore as a token by which to report to Zhaohui, and then died.

sentences.zh: 諡武烈，追封一​​等伯，以一等子世襲，祀賢良、昭忠二祠。

translations.literal: Posthumously titled Wulie ["Martial and Stern"], he was ennobled posthumously as a first-class earl with hereditary succession as a first-class viscount, and enshrined in the Shrines of Worthy Officials and Loyal Souls.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously titled Wulie ("Martial and Stern"), ennobled posthumously as a first-class earl with hereditary succession as a first-class viscount, and enshrined in the Shrines of Worthy Officials and Loyal Souls.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，師還，獲尼瑪及其子檻送京師，命戮於和起墓前。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the army returned; Nima and his son were captured in cages and sent to the capital, and the Emperor ordered them executed before He Qi's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the army returned; Nima and his son were captured in cages and sent to the capital, and the Emperor ordered them executed before He Qi's tomb.

sentences.zh: 子和隆武，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Helongwu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Helongwu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 唐喀祿，他塔喇氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Tang Kalu, of the Tatara clan, was a Bannerman of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kalu, of the Tatara clan, was a Bannerman of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 自筆帖式再遷理籓院員外郎。

translations.literal: From clerk he was promoted again to director of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From clerk he was promoted again to director of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十九年，賜副都統銜，命赴北路軍董理新降輝特台吉阿睦爾撒納、班珠爾等游牧地。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he was granted the rank of vice commander and ordered to the northern-route army to oversee the pastures of the newly surrendered Khoyitu'n chieftains Amursana and Banzhu'er.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he was granted the rank of vice commander and sent to the northern-route army to oversee the pastures of the newly surrendered Khoyitu'n chieftains Amursana and Banzhu'er.

sentences.zh: 唐喀祿疏言：「班珠爾所屬多老稚不能耕，慮飢餒。

translations.literal: Tang Kalu memorialized: "Many among Banzhu'er's following are old and young and cannot farm; I fear hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kalu memorialized: "Many among Banzhu'er's following are old and young and cannot farm; I fear they will go hungry.

sentences.zh: 」上以距耕時尚遠，責其瑣屑，命撤還。

translations.literal: " The Emperor, considering the farming season still distant, reproached him for triviality and ordered his recall.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor, considering the planting season still far off, reproached him for pettiness and ordered him recalled.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克林丕勒多爾濟初命同董理游牧，將軍別有指揮，唐喀祿疏請留。

translations.literal: The Jasak Lama Pinpeldorji had initially been ordered to oversee the pastures jointly, but the general had separate instructions; Tang Kalu memorialized asking to remain.
translations.idiomatic: The Jasak Lama Pinpeldorji had initially been ordered to oversee the pastures jointly, but the general had separate instructions; Tang Kalu memorialized asking to stay.

sentences.zh: 上責其不當，左遷理籓院筆帖式。

translations.literal: The Emperor reproached him for impropriety and demoted him to clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reproached him for impropriety and demoted him to clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋复授員外郎，命送濟隆呼圖克圖自巴林赴伊犁，董理定邊右副將軍薩喇爾游牧。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed director and ordered to escort the Jiling Hutuktu from Barin to Ili and to oversee the pastures of Vice Pacification Commissioner Salgar.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again appointed director and ordered to escort the Jiling Hutuktu from Barin to Ili and to oversee the pastures of Vice Pacification Commissioner Salgar.

sentences.zh: 复賜副都統銜，授領隊大臣，將駐防扎布堪兵千人，從定邊右副將軍哈達哈赴哈薩克，逐捕阿睦爾撒納。

translations.literal: He was again granted the rank of vice commander, appointed a leading detachments commissioner, and ordered to lead a thousand garrison troops at Zhabukan to accompany Vice Pacification Commissioner Hadaha to Kazakhstan in pursuit of Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: He was again granted the rank of vice commander, appointed a leading detachments commissioner, and ordered to lead a thousand garrison troops at Zhabukan accompanying Vice Pacification Commissioner Hadaha to Kazakhstan in pursuit of Amursana.

sentences.zh: 賊渠固爾班和卓遁入烏梁海，唐喀祿報哈達哈督兵擒之，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Gu'erban Hezhuo fled into the Urianghai territory; Tang Kalu reported to Hadaha to dispatch troops and capture him, and was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel chief Gu'erban Hezhuo fled into Urianghai territory; Tang Kalu reported to Hadaha to dispatch troops and capture him, and was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納令其徒達瓦藏布入掠，唐喀祿令索倫總管鄂博什將五百人御之，降其眾三百。

translations.literal: Amursana sent his follower Davazangbu to raid; Tang Kalu ordered the Solon commandant Eboshi to lead five hundred men against them and induced three hundred to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana sent his follower Davazangbu to raid; Tang Kalu ordered the Solon commandant Eboshi to lead five hundred men against them and brought three hundred to surrender.

sentences.zh: 尋命屯科布多。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to encamp at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to encamp at Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 授理籓院侍郎、鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice director of the Court of Colonial Affairs and vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the Court of Colonial Affairs and vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 唐喀祿行按諸部，輝特降人屯紮克賽，每自相劫奪，請移屯呼倫貝爾、齊齊哈爾諸地；

translations.literal: As Tang Kalu toured the tribes, Khoyitu'n who had surrendered were stationed at Zhakesai, where they repeatedly robbed one another; he requested that they be moved to pastures in Hulunbuir, Qiqihar, and elsewhere;
translations.idiomatic: As Tang Kalu toured the tribes, surrendered Khoyitu'n were stationed at Zhakesai, where they repeatedly robbed one another; he requested that they be moved to pastures in Hulunbuir, Qiqihar, and elsewhere;

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀俘獲扎哈沁、特楞古特、奇爾吉斯、烏爾罕濟蘭諸部人萬餘，請以扎哈沁人移駐卡倫內；

translations.literal: over ten thousand captives of the Zakhachin, Terengut, Kirghiz, and Uyerhanjilan tribes taken by the Khalkha—he requested that the Zakhachin be moved to garrison inside the passes;
translations.idiomatic: more than ten thousand captives of the Zakhachin, Terengut, Kirghiz, and Uyerhanjilan tribes taken by the Khalkha—he requested that the Zakhachin be moved to garrison inside the passes;

sentences.zh: 特楞古特、奇爾吉斯、烏爾罕濟蘭人給東三省兵丁為奴；

translations.literal: the Terengut, Kirghiz, and Uyerhanjilan were to be given as slaves to troops in the Three Eastern Provinces;
translations.idiomatic: the Terengut, Kirghiz, and Uyerhanjilan were to be given as slaves to troops in the Three Eastern Provinces;

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特游牧請移烏蘭固木：上並從其請。

translations.literal: the Dorbed requested relocation of their pastures to Ulan Gum—the Emperor approved all his requests.
translations.idiomatic: the Dorbed requested relocation of their pastures to Ulan Gum: the Emperor approved all his requests.

sentences.zh: 師出西路擊哈薩克錫喇，命唐喀祿屯額爾齊斯為聲援。

translations.literal: When the army marched on the western route against Hasakesira, the Emperor ordered Tang Kalu to encamp on the Irtysh as a supporting force.
translations.idiomatic: When the army marched on the western route against Hasakesira, the Emperor ordered Tang Kalu to encamp on the Irtysh as a supporting force.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納敗走，唐喀祿诇知杜爾伯特貝勒巴圖博羅特、台吉阿喇善等潛與相結；

translations.literal: Amursana fled in defeat; Tang Kalu learned by espionage that the Dorbed prince Batuborot, the chieftain Alashan, and others were secretly in league with him;
translations.idiomatic: Amursana fled in defeat; Tang Kalu learned by espionage that the Dorbed prince Batuborot, the chieftain Alashan, and others were secretly in league with him;

sentences.zh: 遣兵攻之輝巴朗山，擒阿喇善等，並戮烏梁海五十餘戶，遂赴塔爾巴哈台逐捕阿睦爾撒納及哈薩克錫喇，賜御用荷包、鼻煙壺。

translations.literal: he sent troops to attack them on Huibolang Mountain, captured Alashan and others, and executed over fifty Urianghai households, then went to Tarbagatai in pursuit of Amursana and Hasakesira and was granted an imperial purse and snuff bottle.
translations.idiomatic: he sent troops to attack them on Huibolang Mountain, captured Alashan and others, and executed more than fifty Urianghai households, then went to Tarbagatai in pursuit of Amursana and Hasakesira and was granted an imperial purse and snuff bottle.

sentences.zh: 師至塔爾巴哈台，糧罄馬乏，唐喀祿引師退，疏言遵旨撤兵，上怒，左授藍翎侍衛，佐定邊左副將軍納穆扎爾出北路。

translations.literal: When the army reached Tarbagatai, provisions were exhausted and horses weary; Tang Kalu led the army back and memorialized that he was withdrawing troops on orders; the Emperor was angered and demoted him to Blue-Plume Bodyguard, to assist Vice Pacification Commissioner Namuzhargar on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Tarbagatai, provisions ran out and horses were exhausted; Tang Kalu led the army back and memorialized that he was withdrawing on orders; the Emperor was angered and demoted him to Blue-Plume Bodyguard to assist Vice Pacification Commissioner Namuzhargar on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 降人和碩齊，上擢用至散秩大臣，至是令護哈薩克來使入邊，上命納穆扎爾遣唐喀祿將二百人迎之。

translations.literal: Hosergi, a surrendered chief, had been raised by the Emperor to honorary minister; he was now ordered to escort Kazakh envoys across the border; the Emperor ordered Namuzhargar to dispatch Tang Kalu with two hundred men to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: Hosergi, a surrendered chief, had been raised by the Emperor to honorary minister; he was now ordered to escort Kazakh envoys across the border; the Emperor ordered Namuzhargar to send Tang Kalu with two hundred men to receive them.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納竄俄羅斯，上命唐喀祿偕和碩齊駐額爾齊斯偵禦。

translations.literal: Amursana fled to Russia; the Emperor ordered Tang Kalu, together with Hosergi, to encamp on the Irtysh to spy and defend.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana fled to Russia; the Emperor ordered Tang Kalu, together with Hosergi, to encamp on the Irtysh to spy and defend.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月，土爾扈特舍棱等謀走俄羅斯，上命偕和碩齊逐捕。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-third year, the Torghut chief Shelei and others plotted flight to Russia; the Emperor ordered him, together with Hosergi, to pursue them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-third year the Torghut chief Shelei and others plotted flight to Russia; the Emperor ordered him, together with Hosergi, to pursue them.

sentences.zh: 四月，師次佈固圖河，獲舍棱弟勞章扎卜。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the army reached the Bugutu River and captured Shelei's younger brother Lao Zhangzhabu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the army reached the Bugutu River and captured Shelei's younger brother Lao Zhangzhabu.

sentences.zh: 勞章扎卜詭為兄乞降，唐喀祿未敢信，和碩齊遽縱之還。

translations.literal: Lao Zhangzhabu falsely begged surrender on his brother's behalf; Tang Kalu did not dare believe it, but Hosergi at once released him to return.
translations.idiomatic: Lao Zhangzhabu falsely begged surrender on his brother's behalf; Tang Kalu did not dare believe it, but Hosergi at once let him go back.

sentences.zh: 越日，舍棱詭約降，獻酒，和碩齊飲之，邀唐喀祿過其營，賊噪而起。

translations.literal: The next day Shelei falsely offered surrender and presented wine; Hosergi drank it and invited Tang Kalu to his camp, where the rebels raised a clamor and rose up.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Shelei falsely offered surrender and presented wine; Hosergi drank it and invited Tang Kalu to his camp, where the rebels raised a clamor and rose up.

sentences.zh: 唐喀祿及侍衛富錫爾、穆倫保、佛爾慶額力戰，均遇害，和碩齊更衣降。

translations.literal: Tang Kalu, together with the guardsmen Fuxi'er, Mulunbao, and Fo'erqing'e, fought fiercely and all perished; Hosergi changed clothes and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Kalu, together with the guardsmen Fuxi'er, Mulunbao, and Fo'erqing'e, fought fiercely and all perished; Hosergi changed clothes and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賜騎都尉世職，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: When word reached the court, a hereditary cavalry commandant's office was granted and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, a hereditary cavalry commandant's office was granted and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.

sentences.zh: 富錫爾、佛爾慶額，皆滿洲鑲黃旗人；

translations.literal: Fuxi'er and Fo'erqing'e were both Bannermen of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner;
translations.idiomatic: Fuxi'er and Fo'erqing'e were both Bannermen of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner;

sentences.zh: 穆倫保，滿洲正白旗人：皆賜雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Mulunbao was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain White Banner: all were granted hereditary cloud-rider commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Mulunbao was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain White Banner: all were granted hereditary cloud-rider commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 阿敏道，圖爾格期氏，蒙古鑲紅旗人，世居察哈爾。

translations.literal: A Min Dao, of the Turgeqi clan, was a Bannerman of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner, with his family long resident in Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: A Min Dao, of the Turgeqi clan, was a Bannerman of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner; his family had long resided in Chahar.

sentences.zh: 父阿吉斯，康熙間討噶爾丹，以員外郎從軍，中道糧匱，兵苦飢。

translations.literal: His father Ajisi, in the Kangxi reign when campaigning against Galdan, followed the army as a director; midway provisions ran short and the troops suffered cruel hunger.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ajisi, in the Kangxi reign when campaigning against Galdan, followed the army as a director; midway provisions ran short and the troops suffered bitter hunger.

sentences.zh: 阿吉斯言於眾曰：「我等官兵世受國恩，甘斃道路。

translations.literal: Ajisi said to the troops: "We officers and soldiers have received the state's grace for generations and would gladly die on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Ajisi said to the men: "We officers and soldiers have received the state's grace for generations and would gladly die on the road.

sentences.zh: 誓竭力前進。

translations.literal: We swear to press forward with all our strength.
translations.idiomatic: We swear to press forward with all our strength.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆諾。

translations.literal: " All assented.
translations.idiomatic: " All assented.

sentences.zh: 於是有昭莫多之勝。

translations.literal: Thus came the victory at Zhaomodo.
translations.idiomatic: Thus came the victory at Zhaomodo.

sentences.zh: 聖祖嘉其能，予拖沙喇哈番世職。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor praised his ability and granted a hereditary office of tosalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: The Kangxi Emperor praised his ability and granted a hereditary office of tosalahafan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 阿敏道，襲職。

translations.literal: A Min Dao inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: A Min Dao inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，累遷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In the early Yongzheng reign he was repeatedly promoted to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yongzheng reign he rose in repeated promotions to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 九年，命將巴里呼兵百人自固爾班塞堪赴巴爾坤佐軍，又命偕侍讀學士查克丹調喀爾喀兵三千率之往。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was ordered to lead a hundred Barhu troops from Gu'erban Saikan to Barkul to assist the army, and again ordered, together with Reader of the Hanlin Academy Zhakedan, to muster three thousand Khalkha troops and lead them thither.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was ordered to lead a hundred Barhu troops from Gu'erban Saikan to Barkul to assist the army, and again ordered, together with Reader of the Hanlin Academy Zhakedan, to muster three thousand Khalkha troops and lead them thither.

sentences.zh: 尋复偕護軍統領費雅思哈赴烏爾輝音扎罕練兵。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered, together with Guards Commander Feiyasaha, to go to Wuerhuiyin Zhahan to drill troops.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again ordered, together with Guards Commander Feiyasaha, to go to Wuerhuiyin Zhahan to drill troops.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，準噶爾乞和，撤軍，阿敏道還京，授鑲藍旗察哈爾總管。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong the Zunghars sued for peace, the army was withdrawn, and A Min Dao returned to the capital and was appointed Chahar commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong the Zunghars sued for peace, the army was withdrawn, and A Min Dao returned to the capital and was appointed Chahar commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十九年，師收烏梁海，將察哈爾兵以從，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, when the army recovered the Urianghai territory, he led Chahar troops in the campaign and was granted the rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, when the army recovered Urianghai territory, he led Chahar troops in the campaign and was granted the rank of vice commander.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遷所獲巴爾沁人等於齊拉罕。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he relocated the captured Barhu people to Qilahan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he relocated the captured Barhu people to Qilahan.

sentences.zh: 師定伊犁，定北將軍班第奏以阿敏道督台站。

translations.literal: When the army pacified Ili, Pacification Commissioner in the North Bandi memorialized that A Min Dao should supervise the relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: When the army pacified Ili, Pacification Commissioner in the North Bandi memorialized that A Min Dao should supervise the relay stations.

sentences.zh: 是年，阿睦爾撒納叛，班第陷賊。

translations.literal: That year Amursana rebelled and Bandi was trapped by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: That year Amursana rebelled and Bandi was trapped by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 阿巴噶斯、哈丹附逆肆掠，台站中斷。

translations.literal: Abagasi and Hadan joined the rebellion and plundered wildly, and the relay stations were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Abagasi and Hadan joined the rebellion and plundered wildly, and the relay stations were cut off.

sentences.zh: 阿敏道輒督兵巡徼，使驛遞恆得相續。

translations.literal: A Min Dao repeatedly led troops on patrol so that the courier service could remain unbroken.
translations.idiomatic: A Min Dao repeatedly led troops on patrol so that the courier service could remain unbroken.

sentences.zh: 會定西將軍永常自木壘退駐烏爾圖布拉克，撤阿敏道還。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner in the West Yongchang had withdrawn from Mulei to encamp at Wueritu Bulake and recalled A Min Dao.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner in the West Yongchang had withdrawn from Mulei to encamp at Wueritu Bulake and recalled A Min Dao.

sentences.zh: 上奪永常官，以策楞代將。

translations.literal: The Emperor stripped Yongchang of rank and replaced him with Celeng as commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor stripped Yongchang of rank and replaced him with Celeng as commander.

sentences.zh: 命阿敏道將精騎詣伊犁求班第消息。

translations.literal: He ordered A Min Dao to lead picked cavalry to Ili to seek news of Bandi.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered A Min Dao to lead picked cavalry to Ili to seek news of Bandi.

sentences.zh: 策楞不即遣，上詰責之。

translations.literal: Celeng did not dispatch him at once; the Emperor rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng did not dispatch him at once; the Emperor rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 尋將千人捕阿巴噶斯、哈丹賊眾。

translations.literal: Soon he led a thousand men to capture the rebel bands of Abagasi and Hadan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he led a thousand men to capture the rebel bands of Abagasi and Hadan.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed vice commander of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 時回酋布拉呢敦、霍集占有異志，定邊右副將軍兆惠诇知之，遣阿敏道將索倫兵百、厄魯特兵三千赴葉爾羌、喀什噶爾慰撫，且使致二渠。

translations.literal: At that time the Muslim chieftains Burhanuddin and Khojijaha harbored disloyal designs; Vice Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui learned this by espionage and dispatched A Min Dao with a hundred Solon troops and three thousand Oirat troops to Yarkand and Kashgar to reassure the people and also to summon the two chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Muslim chieftains Burhanuddin and Khojijaha harbored disloyal designs; Vice Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui learned this by espionage and dispatched A Min Dao with a hundred Solon troops and three thousand Oirat troops to Yarkand and Kashgar to reassure the people and also to summon the two chieftains.

sentences.zh: 至庫車，霍集占佈在焉，閉城拒我師。

translations.literal: When he reached Kucha, Khojijaha was there; the city was closed and refused our army.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Kucha, Khojijaha was there; the city was closed and refused our army.

sentences.zh: 阿敏道斬遊騎四十餘，圍之。

translations.literal: A Min Dao beheaded over forty mounted scouts and besieged the city.
translations.idiomatic: A Min Dao beheaded over forty mounted scouts and besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 城人詭言曰：「厄魯特吾仇，慮為害。

translations.literal: The townspeople spoke deceitfully, saying: "The Oirats are our enemies; we fear they will harm us.
translations.idiomatic: The townspeople spoke deceitfully, saying: "The Oirats are our enemies; we fear they will harm us.

sentences.zh: 撤還即納降。

translations.literal: Withdraw them and we will submit at once."
translations.idiomatic: Withdraw them and we will submit at once."

sentences.zh: 」阿敏道遂命厄魯特兵退，僅留索倫兵百。

translations.literal: " A Min Dao then ordered the Oirat troops to withdraw, leaving only a hundred Solon soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: " A Min Dao then ordered the Oirat troops to withdraw, leaving only a hundred Solon soldiers.

sentences.zh: 或慮有變，阿敏道曰：「吾招撫回眾，惟期於國有濟，何暇他慮？

translations.literal: Some feared treachery; A Min Dao said: "I am winning over the Muslim masses and look only to what benefits the state—how can I spare thought for anything else?
translations.idiomatic: Some feared treachery; A Min Dao said: "I am winning over the Muslim masses and look only to what benefits the state—how can I spare thought for anything else?

sentences.zh: 」遂入，為霍集占所執。

translations.literal: " He then entered and was seized by Khojijaha.
translations.idiomatic: " He then entered and was seized by Khojijaha.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上諭諸將檄霍集占送阿敏道還，不從，謀加害。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the Emperor instructed the generals to send a proclamation demanding that Khojijaha return A Min Dao; he refused and plotted harm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Emperor instructed the generals to send a proclamation demanding that Khojijaha return A Min Dao; he refused and plotted harm.

sentences.zh: 庫車伯克呼岱巴爾以告，阿敏道謀脫歸，不克，死之。

translations.literal: The Kucha beg Hudaibar informed him; A Min Dao plotted escape but could not succeed and died.
translations.idiomatic: The Kucha beg Hudaibar informed him; A Min Dao plotted escape but could not succeed and died.

sentences.zh: 二等男署察哈爾營總旺扎勒及諸裨將繃科、耨金吹、扎木蘇

translations.literal: Acting Chahar camp commandant Wangzhale of second-rank baron rank, together with the lieutenant generals Bengke, Noujinchui, and Zhamusu
translations.idiomatic: Acting Chahar camp commandant Wangzhale of second-rank baron rank, together with the lieutenant generals Bengke, Noujinchui, and Zhamusu

sentences.zh: 七、巴克薩拾，並索倫兵百人，皆從死。

translations.literal: Qi, Bakasa, and a hundred Solon soldiers—all died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, Bakasa, and a hundred Solon soldiers—all died with him.

sentences.zh: 事平，諸有功者圖形紫光閣，阿敏道列後五十功臣，加世職為騎都尉兼一云騎尉，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, those who had merit were portrayed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; A Min Dao was listed among the fifty later meritorious ministers, his hereditary office was raised to cavalry commandant with one additional cloud-rider commandant, and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, those who had merit were portrayed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; A Min Dao was listed among the fifty later meritorious ministers, his hereditary office was raised to cavalry commandant with one additional cloud-rider commandant, and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.

sentences.zh: 旺札勒加雲騎尉，繃科等皆予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Wangzhale received an additional cloud-rider commandant; Bengke and the others were all granted hereditary cloud-rider commandant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wangzhale received an additional cloud-rider commandant; Bengke and the others were all granted hereditary cloud-rider commandant offices.

sentences.zh: 滿福，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Man Fu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Man Fu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 自世管佐領累擢拉林副都統。

translations.literal: From hereditary assistant commandant he was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Lalin.
translations.idiomatic: From hereditary assistant commandant he was repeatedly promoted to vice commander of Lalin.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，遷都統，駐巴里坤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong he was transferred to commander and stationed at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong he was transferred to commander and stationed at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 命將吉林兵千人屯吐魯番，尋授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead a thousand Jilin troops to encamp at Turfan and was soon appointed a leading detachments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead a thousand Jilin troops to encamp at Turfan and was soon appointed a leading detachments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 定邊將軍成袞扎佈出珠勒都斯，令滿福將三百人巡視阿勒輝至烏納哈特十三台站，搜剿嗎哈沁。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab marched out from Zhuledusi and ordered Man Fu with three hundred men to inspect the thirteen relay stations from Alehui to Wunahte and to search out and destroy the Mahajin bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Chengunjab marched out from Zhuledusi and ordered Man Fu with three hundred men to inspect the thirteen relay stations from Alehui to Wunahte and to search out and destroy the Mahajin bandits.

sentences.zh: 沙拉斯、嗎唬斯既降复叛，掠台站，上命滿福自阿勒輝往剿，又令巴里坤辦事大臣阿里袞帥師與會。

translations.literal: Shalasi and Mahusi had surrendered and then rebelled again, raiding the relay stations; the Emperor ordered Man Fu to proceed from Alehui to suppress them and also ordered the minister in charge at Barkul, Aligun, to lead troops to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Shalasi and Mahusi had surrendered and then rebelled again, raiding the relay stations; the Emperor ordered Man Fu to proceed from Alehui to suppress them and also ordered the minister in charge at Barkul, Aligun, to lead troops to join him.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞未至，滿福師次肯色嶺，與賊遇，擊之，賊敗走，偽遣人乞降，且言賊渠已就縛，請除道迎。

translations.literal: Before Aligun arrived, Man Fu's army reached Kense Ridge, met the enemy, attacked them, and the enemy fled in defeat; they falsely sent men to beg surrender and said the rebel chieftain was already bound, asking that the road be cleared to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: Before Aligun arrived, Man Fu's army reached Kense Ridge, met the enemy, attacked them, and the enemy fled in defeat; they falsely sent men to beg surrender and said the rebel chieftain was already bound, asking that the road be cleared to receive them.

sentences.zh: 滿福信之，行次哈喇和落，徑險林密，下臨深溝。

translations.literal: Man Fu believed them; marching to Halaholuo, the route ran through dense dangerous forest with a deep ravine below.
translations.idiomatic: Man Fu believed them; marching to Halaholuo, the route ran through dense dangerous forest with a deep ravine below.

sentences.zh: 滿福悟為賊所紿，急麾前隊返。

translations.literal: Man Fu realized he had been deceived by the rebels and urgently ordered the vanguard to turn back.
translations.idiomatic: Man Fu realized he had been deceived by the rebels and urgently ordered the vanguard to turn back.

sentences.zh: 賊千餘突自林中出，圍我師。

translations.literal: Over a thousand rebels suddenly burst from the forest and surrounded our army.
translations.idiomatic: Over a thousand rebels suddenly burst from the forest and surrounded our army.

sentences.zh: 滿福厲聲督兵力戰，被創墜溝，死之。

translations.literal: Man Fu sternly urged the troops to fight with all their strength; wounded, he fell into the ravine and died.
translations.idiomatic: Man Fu sternly urged the troops to fight with all their strength; wounded, he fell into the ravine and died.

sentences.zh: 上以滿福雖為賊所愚，愍其捐軀，命如陣亡例議卹，諡武毅，祀昭忠祠，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: The Emperor, though Man Fu had been fooled by the rebels, pitied his sacrifice of life and ordered condolence payments as for death in battle, posthumously titled him Wuyi, enshrined him in the Shrine of Loyal Souls, and placed his portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, though Man Fu had been fooled by the rebels, pitied his sacrifice of life and ordered condolence payments as for death in battle, posthumously titled him Wuyi, enshrined him in the Shrine of Loyal Souls, and placed his portrait in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 豆斌，陝西固原人。

translations.literal: Dou Bin was a native of Guyuan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Bin was a native of Guyuan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 初以馬兵入提標，累遷肅州鎮標中營守備。

translations.literal: He first entered the provincial command as a cavalry soldier and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander of the central battalion of the Jiuquan garrison standard.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered the provincial command as a cavalry soldier and was repeatedly promoted to garrison commander of the central battalion of the Jiuquan garrison standard.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，從征準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign he followed the campaign against the Zunghars.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng reign he followed the campaign against the Zunghars.

sentences.zh: 力戰受創，賜白金四百。

translations.literal: Fighting fiercely he was wounded and was granted four hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting fiercely he was wounded and was granted four hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 遷川陝督標前營游擊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to brigade commander of the forward battalion of the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor's standard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to brigade commander of the forward battalion of the Sichuan-Shaanxi governor's standard.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾犯科舍圖，率兵擊走之。

translations.literal: When the Zunghars attacked Keshetu he led troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zunghars attacked Keshetu he led troops and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，累遷提督，自廣東移廣西。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong reign he was repeatedly promoted to provincial commander, moving from Guangdong to Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign he was repeatedly promoted to provincial commander, moving from Guangdong to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「各營鳥槍，舊式大小參差，坐臥倚伏，不能應手；

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The muskets in the various camps, in the old style, vary in large and small size; sitting, lying, leaning, or crouching, they cannot be handled readily;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The muskets in the various camps, in the old style, vary in large and small size; sitting, lying, leaning, or crouching, they cannot be handled readily;

sentences.zh: 又質薄易熱，難收實用。

translations.literal: moreover the metal is thin and heats easily, so they are hard to use effectively.
translations.idiomatic: moreover the metal is thin and heats easily, so they are hard to use effectively.

sentences.zh: 請照陝西威字號纏絲槍式改制。

translations.literal: I request that they be remade according to the wrapped-silk musket pattern of Shaanxi's Wei battalion."
translations.idiomatic: I request that they be remade according to the wrapped-silk musket pattern of Shaanxi's Wei battalion."

sentences.zh: 」下兩廣總督議行。

translations.literal: " The order was sent down to the governors-general of Guangdong and Guangxi to implement it.
translations.idiomatic: " The order was sent down to the governors-general of Guangdong and Guangxi to implement it.

sentences.zh: 俄，調還固原。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred back to Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred back to Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 又命以提督銜領湖北宜昌鎮總兵事。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to lead the affairs of commander of Yichang Garrison in Hubei with the rank of provincial commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered to lead the affairs of commander of Yichang Garrison in Hubei with the rank of provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 尋复歷甘肅、安西提督。

translations.literal: He soon served again as provincial commander of Gansu and Anxi in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He soon served again as provincial commander of Gansu and Anxi in succession.

sentences.zh: 命討準噶爾，帥將標兵出駐巴里坤，以輸軍馬後時，下吏議。

translations.literal: Ordered to campaign against the Zunghars, he led the provincial standard troops out to encamp at Barkul; because army horses arrived late he was referred to the magistrates for judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to campaign against the Zunghars, he led the provincial standard troops out to encamp at Barkul; because army horses arrived late he was referred to the magistrates for judgment.

sentences.zh: 旋乞病，罷。

translations.literal: Soon he begged leave on grounds of illness and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he begged leave on grounds of illness and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 居數月，复授安西提督，仍令赴巴里坤兆惠師。

translations.literal: After several months he was again appointed provincial commander of Anxi and still ordered to join Zhaohui's army at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: After several months he was again appointed provincial commander of Anxi and still ordered to join Zhaohui's army at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 師攻霍集占於庫車，命斌將所部從，充領隊大臣，徼巡魯克察克、闢展、庫車諸地驛路。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Khojijaha at Kucha, Bin was ordered to lead his division in the campaign as a leading detachments commissioner and to patrol the courier routes of Lukchak, Bicheng, Kucha, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Khojijaha at Kucha, Bin was ordered to lead his division in the campaign as a leading detachments commissioner and to patrol the courier routes of Lukchak, Bicheng, Kucha, and other places.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被圍黑水，斌從副將軍富德自阿克蘇兼程赴援。

translations.literal: When Zhaohui was besieged at the Black Water, Bin followed Vice General Fude from Aksu on a forced march to relieve him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaohui was besieged at the Black Water, Bin followed Vice General Fude from Aksu on a forced march to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 師次呼爾璊，霍集占以五千人迎戰，我師分兩翼，賊據高岡，斌率中軍火器進攻。

translations.literal: When the army reached Huyiru'n, Khojijaha met them with five thousand men; our army divided into two wings; the enemy held the high hills, and Bin led the center with firearms in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Huyiru'n, Khojijaha met them with five thousand men; our army divided into two wings; the enemy held the high hills, and Bin led the center with firearms in the attack.

sentences.zh: 賊知我師馬力乏，擁眾相偪。

translations.literal: The rebels, knowing our army's horses were exhausted, massed their numbers and pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels, knowing our army's horses were exhausted, massed their numbers and pressed close.

sentences.zh: 阿里袞解馬至，斌偕眾將夾擊，脅中創，仍力戰，賊大敗。

translations.literal: Aligun sent horses up; Bin together with the other generals attacked from both sides; struck in the flank he was wounded but still fought fiercely, and the rebels were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Aligun sent horses up; Bin together with the other generals attacked from both sides; struck in the flank he was wounded but still fought fiercely, and the rebels were utterly defeated.

sentences.zh: 創甚遂卒，諡壯節，祀昭忠祠，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉。

translations.literal: His wounds were severe and he soon died; he was posthumously titled Zhuangjie, enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls, and granted a hereditary office of cavalry commandant with concurrent cloud-rider commandant.
translations.idiomatic: His wounds were severe and he soon died; he was posthumously titled Zhuangjie, enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls, and granted a hereditary office of cavalry commandant with concurrent cloud-rider commandant.

sentences.zh: 上製詩惜之。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem to mourn him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor composed a poem to mourn him.

sentences.zh: 回部平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the Muslim regions were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muslim regions were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 孫{澍}，襲世職，官至山東登州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: His grandson Shu inherited the hereditary office and rose to commander of Dengzhou Garrison in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Shu inherited the hereditary office and rose to commander of Dengzhou Garrison in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 端濟布，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Duan Ji Bu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ji Bu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒累遷頭等侍衛、鑲黃旗察哈爾總管。

translations.literal: From the vanguard he was repeatedly promoted to first-rank bodyguard and Chahar commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: From the vanguard he was repeatedly promoted to first-rank bodyguard and Chahar commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，上令選兵千佐定邊將軍兆惠出西路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Emperor ordered the selection of a thousand troops to assist Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Emperor ordered the selection of a thousand troops to assist Pacification Commissioner Zhaohui on the western route.

sentences.zh: 自硃爾圖斯赴瑪納斯，獲得木齊鄂羅斯，並所部三百人、馬駝牛羊二千餘。

translations.literal: From Zhuer Tusi he went to Manasi, captured Demuchi of Urumqi together with his following of three hundred men and over two thousand horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhuer Tusi he went to Manasi, captured Demuchi of Urumqi together with his following of three hundred men and over two thousand horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁頭人巴哈曼集叛走，端濟布偕侍衛奎瑪岱追捕，至小衛和勒津，降所部二百戶，又得掠台站賊札木布。

translations.literal: The Zakhachin headman Bahamanji had rebelled and fled; Duan Ji Bu together with guardsman Kuimadai pursued him to Xiao Weihejin, induced two hundred households to surrender, and also captured Zhamubu, who had raided the relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: The Zakhachin headman Bahamanji had rebelled and fled; Duan Ji Bu together with guardsman Kuimadai pursued him to Xiao Weihejin, induced two hundred households to surrender, and also captured Zhamubu, who had raided the relay stations.

sentences.zh: 師捕治厄魯特頭人噶爾藏多爾濟、扎那噶爾布等，布魯古特台吉琿齊、呼爾璊台吉達瓦斬扎那噶爾布，詣端濟布軍請降。

translations.literal: When the army pursued and punished the Oirat headmen Garzang Dorji, Zanagarbu, and others, the Burut chieftain Hunchi and the Khoyiru'n chieftain Dawa beheaded Zanagarbu and came to Duan Ji Bu's army to request surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When the army pursued and punished the Oirat headmen Garzang Dorji, Zanagarbu, and others, the Burut chieftain Hunchi and the Khoyiru'n chieftain Dawa beheaded Zanagarbu and came to Duan Ji Bu's army to request surrender.

sentences.zh: 端濟布遽引師還，琿齊、達瓦复叛去。

translations.literal: Duan Ji Bu abruptly led the army back, and Hunchi and Dawa rebelled and fled again.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ji Bu abruptly led the army back, and Hunchi and Dawa rebelled and fled again.

sentences.zh: 上懲端濟布惟事姑息，命靖逆將軍雅爾哈善按治。

translations.literal: The Emperor punished Duan Ji Bu for indulgence alone and ordered Pacification Commissioner Yalihashan to investigate and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor punished Duan Ji Bu for indulgence alone and ordered Pacification Commissioner Yalihashan to investigate and punish him.

sentences.zh: 師至羅克倫孟古圖嶺，獲噶爾藏多爾濟宰桑羅卜札尼瑪、得木齊敦多克，檻送巴里坤。

translations.literal: When the army reached Luokelun Menggutu Ridge they captured Garzang Dorji's chieftain Luobuzhanima and Demuchi Dunduoke and sent them in cages to Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Luokelun Menggutu Ridge they captured Garzang Dorji's chieftain Luobuzhanima and Demuchi Dunduoke and sent them in cages to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 上聞，命貸端濟布罪。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of this he ordered Duan Ji Bu's crime pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard of this he ordered Duan Ji Bu's crime pardoned.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁得木齊哈勒拜等謀掠台站，參贊大臣哈寧阿檄端濟布往捕，至瑪納斯，得間諜十餘。

translations.literal: Demuchi Halebai of the Zakhachin and others plotted to raid the relay stations; participating commissioner Haning'a directed Duan Ji Bu to go capture them; reaching Manasi he obtained more than ten spies.
translations.idiomatic: Demuchi Halebai of the Zakhachin and others plotted to raid the relay stations; participating commissioner Haning'a directed Duan Ji Bu to go capture them; reaching Manasi he obtained more than ten spies.

sentences.zh: 渡河至美羅託山，賊遁，收其游牧牲畜。

translations.literal: Crossing the river to Meiluotuo Mountain, the rebels fled and he seized their pastoral livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the river to Meiluotuo Mountain, the rebels fled and he seized their pastoral livestock.

sentences.zh: 師圍庫車，端濟布將吉林、厄魯特兵以從。

translations.literal: When the army besieged Kucha, Duan Ji Bu led Jilin and Oirat troops in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When the army besieged Kucha, Duan Ji Bu led Jilin and Oirat troops in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 霍集占將三千人自賽里木來援，屯高阜。

translations.literal: Khojijaha led three thousand men from Sailimu to relieve the city and encamped on the high ground.
translations.idiomatic: Khojijaha led three thousand men from Sailimu to relieve the city and encamped on the high ground.

sentences.zh: 端濟布偕侍衛順德納等奮擊，斬二千餘級。

translations.literal: Duan Ji Bu together with guardsman Shunden'a and others fought fiercely and beheaded over two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ji Bu together with guardsman Shunden'a and others fought fiercely and beheaded over two thousand.

sentences.zh: 師攻葉爾羌，霍集占築台城東北。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Yarkand, Khojijaha built a fort northeast of the city.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Yarkand, Khojijaha built a fort northeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 端濟布及侍衛諾爾本將右翼後隊攻之，賊拒戰，复斬二千餘級。

translations.literal: Duan Ji Bu and guardsman Nuo Er Ben led the right-wing rear column to attack it; the rebels resisted, and they again beheaded over two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Ji Bu and guardsman Nuo Er Ben led the right-wing rear column to attack it; the rebels resisted, and they again beheaded over two thousand.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被圍於黑水，端濟布從定邊左副將軍富德赴援，十餘戰，至呼爾璊，與兆惠軍會，賜三等輕車都尉世職，授鑲紅旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: When Zhaohui was besieged at the Black Water, Duan Ji Bu followed Vice Pacification Commissioner in the West Fude to the relief; after more than ten battles they reached Huyiru'n and joined Zhaohui's army; he was granted a hereditary office of third-rank light chariot commandant and appointed vice commander of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaohui was besieged at the Black Water, Duan Ji Bu followed Vice Pacification Commissioner in the West Fude to the relief; after more than ten battles they reached Huyiru'n and joined Zhaohui's army; he was granted a hereditary office of third-rank light chariot commandant and appointed vice commander of the Manchu Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 師逐賊，戰於阿爾楚爾，再戰於伊西洱庫爾淖爾，端濟布將二百人截賊逃路。

translations.literal: Pursuing the rebels, the army fought at A'erchuer and again at Yixi'erku'er Lake; Duan Ji Bu led two hundred men to cut off the enemy's escape route.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing the rebels, the army fought at A'erchuer and again at Yixi'erku'er Lake; Duan Ji Bu led two hundred men to cut off the enemy's escape route.

sentences.zh: 偵山有賊寨，越嶺攻之，被創，賜號塔什巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Espionage revealed an enemy stockade in the mountains; crossing the ridge to attack it, he was wounded and was granted the title Tashibaturu.
translations.idiomatic: Espionage revealed an enemy stockade in the mountains; crossing the ridge to attack it, he was wounded and was granted the title Tashibaturu.

sentences.zh: 師還，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the fifty foremost meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈都統，諡壯節，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously promoted to commander, titled Zhuangjie, and enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.
translations.idiomatic: He died; posthumously promoted to commander, titled Zhuangjie, and enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Souls.

sentences.zh: 諭以「端濟布力戰受傷，與陣亡者無異也」。

translations.literal: An edict stated that "Duan Ji Bu fought fiercely and was wounded, no different from those who fell in battle."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that "Duan Ji Bu fought fiercely and was wounded, no different from those who fell in battle."

sentences.zh: 諾爾本，吳機格忒氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Nuo Er Ben, of the Wujigete clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Nuo Er Ben, of the Wujigete clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒從軍。

translations.literal: He followed the army as a vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the army as a vanguard.

sentences.zh: 富德獲宰桑烏巴什，遣諾爾本送兆惠軍。

translations.literal: Fude captured the chieftain Ubashi and dispatched Nuo Er Ben to deliver him to Zhaohui's army.
translations.idiomatic: Fude captured the chieftain Ubashi and sent Nuo Er Ben to deliver him to Zhaohui's army.

sentences.zh: 道遇賊，力戰，賜號克籌巴圖魯。

translations.literal: On the road they met bandits and fought fiercely; he was granted the title Kechou Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: On the road they encountered bandits and fought fiercely; he received the title Kechou Baturu.

sentences.zh: 師圍庫車，霍集占來援。

translations.literal: When the army besieged Kucha, Khojijaha came to relieve the city.
translations.idiomatic: While the army besieged Kucha, Khojijaha marched to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 諾爾本偕公袞楚克，侍衛齊凌札卜、齊努渾等擊賊右翼，賊敗走，逐之六十餘裡，至鄂根河口，斬獲甚眾；

translations.literal: Nuo Er Ben together with Gonggunchuke and the guardsmen Qilingzhabu, Qihun, and others attacked the enemy's right wing; the enemy fled in defeat, and they pursued them for more than sixty li to the mouth of the Egen River, killing and capturing in great numbers;
translations.idiomatic: Nuo Er Ben joined Gonggunchuke and guardsmen Qilingzhabu, Qihun, and others in striking the enemy's right wing; the enemy broke and fled, and they pursued more than sixty li to the Egen River mouth, killing and capturing in great numbers;

sentences.zh: 賊逃入蘇巴什山，复偕齊努渾入山搜戮：溫詔嘉焉。

translations.literal: the rebels fled into Subashi Mountain, and he again entered the mountain with Qihun to search and slaughter them: the Emperor issued an edict praising this.
translations.idiomatic: the rebels fled into Subashi Mountain; he again entered the hills with Qihun to hunt them down, and the Emperor commended them in an edict.

sentences.zh: 師攻葉爾羌，偕端濟布戰城東，敗賊。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Yarkand, he fought with Duan Ji Bu east of the city and defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Yarkand, he fought east of the city alongside Duan Ji Bu and routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 師還，命在乾清門行走，賚銀帛，賜騎都尉加一云騎尉世職，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, was bestowed silver and silks, granted a hereditary office of cavalry commandant with one additional cloud-rider commandant, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned he was assigned to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, rewarded with silver and silks, granted a hereditary cavalry commandant's office with an additional cloud-rider commandant, and portrayed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 擢頭等侍衛，從明瑞徵緬甸，擊賊被創。

translations.literal: He was promoted to first-rank bodyguard and followed Mingrui in the Burma campaign; attacking the enemy he was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to first-rank bodyguard, he followed Mingrui against Burma and was wounded fighting the enemy.

sentences.zh: 尋令將兵屯騰越。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops encamped at Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to command troops stationed at Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 還京，擢圍場總管，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he was promoted to director of the imperial hunting grounds and granted the rank of vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he was made director of the imperial hunting grounds and granted vice-commander rank.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He passed away.
translations.idiomatic: He passed away.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高天喜驍勇善戰，與鄂實、三格奮鬥破陣，死事為最烈。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Gao Tianxi was brave and skilled in battle; with E Shi and San Ge he fought desperately to break the enemy lines, and of all who died in service none was more resolute.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Gao Tianxi was brave and skilled in battle; with E Shi and San Ge he fought desperately to break the enemy lines, and of all who died in service none was more resolute.

sentences.zh: 和起等倉卒為賊陷，慷慨授命。

translations.literal: Caught unawares, He Qi and the others were trapped by the rebels and laid down their lives with generous resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Caught unawares, He Qi and the others were trapped by the rebels and laid down their lives with generous resolve.

sentences.zh: 斌與端濟布以力戰受創，得與戰死者同其血食。

translations.literal: Because Bin and Duan Ji Bu were wounded in fierce combat, they were honored to receive the same blood sacrifices as the fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Because Bin and Duan Ji Bu were wounded in fierce combat, they were honored to receive the same blood sacrifices as the fallen.

sentences.zh: 旌勇勵忠，當如是也。

translations.literal: To honor the brave and encourage loyalty should indeed be done in this way.
translations.idiomatic: To honor the brave and encourage loyalty should indeed be done in this way.
